definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 'method: A procedural entity defined by a method definition within, or inherited by, a class definition'; 2023 describes the same entity in 9.3.4 instead of its definitions clause. SELF and SUPER are used inside such methods; unchanged.

pending-clause.answer: §2002:9.3.5 binds a method by name only ("if a method with the method-name specified in the invocation is defined in the class of the object, that method is bound"); 2023 9.3.6 adds signature matching (overloading). Both editions send SUPER through the restricted search of the SELF/SUPER clause (§2002:9.3.5 "the invocation will resolve to a method by using a restricted search, as specified in 8.4.2.8, SELF and SUPER"); GR1's identity (both reference the invoking object) does not depend on resolution; l1c28_self_super_invoking_object passes at --std 2002.
